name: Adaptive Merge Grid Construction
definition: A divide-and-conquer strategy that subdivides the spatial domain using an adaptive octree merge grid to localize CSG operations, improving robustness over global approaches by ensuring each cell contains the simplest possible patch relationship.
summary: Adaptive Merge Grid Construction is a divide-and-conquer strategy that uses an adaptive octree to localize CSG operations by ensuring each cell contains only clique patch interactions, prioritizing topological simplicity over geometric balance.
